text:
HOW THIS TEMPLATE WORKS

1. Every shape whose name starts with !! is a morph anchor. Keep the names identical across slides and PowerPoint animates the movement for you. Home > Select > Selection Pane to see them.
2. Morph is already applied to slides 2 to 20. Slides auto-advance so it plays like a video. To present manually, go to Transitions and untick 'After'.
3. To export as video: File > Export > Create a Video.
4. To re-theme for any topic, change three colours: the accent (FF6B35), the second accent (3DDC97) and the background image. Swap the three abstract images for your own photography.
5. Replace every [bracketed] slot with your content. The layout holds at any length because titles are set to shrink text on overflow.
